chess/classic.checkYou: Check! Your move — defend or counter.
chess/classic.heroDesc: Dark-ops chess lab. Pick a side, outsmart the bot, force checkmate, and own the position.
chess/classic.heroTitleHtml: Hack the board. Capture the flag.
chess/classic.rulesHtml:
• Goal: checkmate the opponent’s king.
  • Pieces: rooks move straight, bishops diagonally, queens both ways, knights in an L, and kings one square.
  • Moves: White moves first. You may not leave your king in check.
  • Check and mate: answer check; checkmate ends the game.
  • Special moves: castling, en passant, and pawn promotion.
  • Draw: stalemate, repeated position, insufficient material, or agreement.

chess/custom.heroDesc: Dark-ops chess lab. Pick a side, outsmart the bot, force checkmate, and own the position.
chess/custom.heroTitleHtml: Hack the board. Capture the flag.
chess/custom.rulesHtml:
• Setup: before play, place pieces freely on an empty or standard board.
  • Palette: select a piece (white or black), then a square to place it. Clicking the same piece again removes it; another piece replaces it. A second king of the same color is refused (at most one white and one black king).
  • Start: exactly one white and one black king. If the side to move is already mated — warning, but start is allowed.
  • Play: same as classic — Stockfish, side select, online rooms.
  • Multiplayer: setup FEN is synced; both confirm start or the host starts when ready. Spectators are read-only.

chess/dice.checkYou: Check! Your move — defend or counter.
chess/dice.heroDesc: Dark-ops chess lab. Pick a side, outsmart the bot, force checkmate, and own the position.
chess/dice.heroTitleHtml: Hack the board. Capture the flag.
chess/dice.mpPlayingHint: Move your pieces. Bot is disabled.
chess/dice.rulesHtml:
• Goal: checkmate; in this mode, capturing the king also ends the game.
  • Roll: at the start of a turn roll 1–3 dice: 1 — pawn, 2 — knight, 3 — bishop, 4 — rook, 5 — queen, 6 — king.
  • Moves: make one move for each rolled type; duplicate faces grant multiple moves.
  • Restriction: only rolled piece types may move. A type with no legal move is skipped; if none can move, the turn passes.
  • Chess rules: normal moves, captures, and pawn promotion still apply.

chess/atomic.rulesHtml:
• Capture: the capturing piece, the captured piece, and all pieces within king-adjacent radius 1 of the capture square are removed — except pawns (pawns do not explode).
  • King: if a king is in the blast, that side loses. A move that explodes your own king while the enemy king survives is illegal.
  • Mate: king threatened with explosion/capture and no legal moves.
  • Bot: local search on atomic rules (not Stockfish).
  • Multiplayer: create or join a room by code; spectators are welcome.

chess/knights.checkYou: Check! Your move — defend or counter.
chess/knights.rulesHtml:
• Setup: kings and pawns as in classic chess; every other piece is replaced by a same-color knight.
  • Moves: knights move in an L; pawns and kings are normal. No castling (no rooks).
  • Goal: checkmate or capture the king.
  • Bot: Stockfish on the knights FEN.
  • Multiplayer: create or join a room by code; spectators are welcome.

checkers/classic.rulesHtml:
• Man: moves diagonally forward.
  • Capture is mandatory: capture forward or backward. If several chains are available, choose any.
  • King: moves and captures any distance diagonally.
  • Multi-capture: keep jumping while another capture is available.
  • Win: the opponent has no pieces or no legal moves.

checkers/custom.customSettingsHostOnly: Only the room creator can change settings before the first move
checkers/custom.rulesHtml:
• Base: Russian draughts 8×8 with flying kings.
  • Backward capture: ON — men capture both ways (Russian); OFF — men capture forward only (international-like).
  • Mandatory capture: ON — quiet moves illegal when a capture exists; OFF — quiet moves allowed.
  • Move timer: off / 10 / 30 / 60 / 120 s. Timeout loses for the side to move.
  • Multiplayer: only the room creator owns settings until the first move; if the opponent leaves, continue vs bot.
